reviews.shade: BRING GREEN Super Lemon Glutathione Toner Pad Refill Set(+90EA)
reviews.text: This was a great new product to try! But the lemon scent was a bit sharp so I think I will be sticking to the OG series. (:
reviews.zh: 新產品試得好值得！但檸檬味有少少刺鼻，所以估計我都係會繼續用返原本嗰個系列。(:

reviews.shade: BRING GREEN Super Lemon Glutathione Toner Pad Refill Set(+90EA)
reviews.text: First time using pads from this brand. Very surprised with the results. Love how my skin feels afterwards. I wouldn’t say it’s brightening per say, but it definitely leaves the skin texture nice and smooth
reviews.zh: 第一次用呢個品牌嘅化妝棉。效果出乎意料。用完之後皮膚嘅觸感好正。唔會話特別提亮，但用完之後皮膚質地真係又滑又細緻。

reviews.shade: BRING GREEN Super Lemon Glutathione Toner Pad Refill Set(+90EA)
reviews.text: Left my skin with red patches, not sure if there’s an ingredient in there that doesn’t agree with me but sadly won’t be purchasing again.
reviews.zh: 用了之後皮膚出現紅塊，唔知係咪入面有啲成分同我夾唔到，但好可惜唔會再買。

reviews.shade: BRING GREEN Super Lemon Glutathione Toner Pad Refill Set(+90EA)
reviews.text: It’s a very good size, it adheres to the face well but it tends to fall when I put a pad on my neck, I haven’t really noticed any brightening yet but it is very hydrating
reviews.zh: 大細啱啱好，貼住塊面好貼服，但敷喺頸嘅時候容易跌。暫時未見到明顯提亮效果，但保濕真係好好

reviews.shade: BRING GREEN Super Lemon Glutathione Toner Pad Refill Set(+90EA)
reviews.text: I am obsessed with toner pads in general and these ones are really nice and hydrating. Good for Dry Mature skin
reviews.zh: 我一向對爽膚水敷膜非常著迷，呢款用落真係好正，而且好保濕。適合乾性熟齡肌。

reviews.shade: BRING GREEN Super Lemon Glutathione Toner Pad Refill Set(+90EA)
reviews.text:
トナーパットは毎日使うものなので、大容量で嬉しいです。
ビタミンC系は肌が荒れることがありますが、こちらも商品は大丈夫でした。
柑橘系の香りに癒されます。
reviews.zh:
爽膚水敷膜係每日都用嘅嘢，大容量真係好開心。
維他命C類嘅產品有時會令皮膚敏感，但呢款就冇問題。
柑橘類嘅香味好治癒。

reviews.text:
Smell so good! smells like real lemon without sour.
It's refreshing, cooling and soothing. :)

味道好好聞！似真嘅檸檬但唔酸。
用落清爽、涼浸浸、好舒緩。:)
